fomod.Name: FP Gunplay Overhaul
fomod.Author: The Shiny Haxorus
fomod.Description: Spring-based weapon inertia and gunplay extras for Fallout 4 first person. Includes camera look inertia, movement sway, ADS scaling, fire recovery, contextual lean, super sprint, weapon-based FOV, and more. Fully customizable via F4SE Menu Framework.
